changelog: rs-2026.09.0: 初版。正式仕様 docs/RUNNING_PRESCRIPTION_ENGINE_V2_SPEC.md の §3-§10 をデータ化。全 Evidence は SECONDARY_REPORT_ONLY、status=DRAFT（一次資料未照合のため ACTIVE 化しない）。

R3: added versioned constraints (U12 hard constraints, U15 ASSISTED_SPRINT non-overridable, maturity/training-age auto-complexity caps), SessionTemplate complexity (§7.5) and EligibilityRule.requiresPhaseEvaluation metadata. methods/envelopes/evidence/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/plausibility values unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R4: added structured machine-readable metadata so planning never parses human-readable text or identifier names: EligibilityRule.conditions / autoGenerationLimits (previously only described in conditionNote), SessionTemplate.approachType / resistanceBand / fixedDistanceField, StopPolicy.appliesToEligibilityPath, PlausibilityRule.inputTarget, and eventDefinitions (timed-mark and race-event distances). conditionNote is now explanatory only. methods/envelopes/evidence/timingTolerances/constraints and all stop-policy/plausibility/envelope numeric values unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R5: added versioned readinessRules (§13 pain red flag groups, pain PRESENT / NOT_ASKED gates, growth-period guidance regions, wellness thresholds and signal counts, readiness-window rule, SWAP target map). No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/eligibility/constraints/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/plausibility/eventDefinitions are byte-identical. Status remains DRAFT.

R6: added versioned aggregationRules (§11 accel interval A per tier, relay allowance, per-Method aggregation metadata, high-intensity budget, tempo/stride session limits, legacy category semantics) and plausibility outputTarget metadata. No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/eligibility/constraints/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/readinessRules/eventDefinitions and every plausibility threshold are unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R7: added versioned weeklyRules (§12 48h/72h window hours, relevant categories, high-sessions-7d threshold, U15 rest-days/hours guards, history-unknown policy), phaseRules (§14.2 per-phase method priority, dose position cap, blocked autogen load classes, PRE_COMPETITION injury-transition info), and competitionRules (§14.3 day-0..14 windows per priority/tier, autogen-exception metadata for STRIDE/ACC<=20m, new-stimulus policy, LONG-INCOMPLETE eligibility, §14.4 taper guidance for ADVANCED x PEAK x day 8-14 only). Added EligibilityConditions.requiresPhaseNotIn and set it on ELIG_SES_POST (blocks AUTO during TRANSITION; behaviorally redundant with TRANSITION's own blockedAutogenLoadClasses for HIGH_METABOLIC, kept as a single AND condition for representability). No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/constraints/timingTolerances/stopPolicies/readinessRules/aggregationRules/plausibility thresholds/eventDefinitions and all pre-existing eligibility outcomes/overrideAllowed/conditionNote text are unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

R8: added StopPolicy.runtime structured metadata (§10.3 machine-readable runtime behavior: timingEvaluation, reference strategy, first/consecutive failure actions, TE too-fast warning threshold, ACC/MV poor-start threshold, technique/vdec/effort actions, planned count unit) so that monitorRunningPrescription never parses stop policy ids or ruleDescriptionJa. The values restate the existing §10.3 table only; existing consecutiveFailuresToStop / numericStopAvailable / descriptions and all timingTolerances are unchanged. No numeric or scientific data changed: methods/templates/envelopes/evidence/eligibility/constraints/timingTolerances/readinessRules/aggregationRules/weeklyRules/phaseRules/competitionRules/plausibility/eventDefinitions are unchanged. Status remains DRAFT.

OPEN20 Phase 3B (DRAFT): E10 Vdec is represented by targeted non-overlapping classification bands and no numeric Vdec prescription; E15 growth velocity remains CHECK_ONLY; E16 taper values are ENGINE_POLICY rather than sprint-specific source-backed recommendations; E21 universal U15 weekly rules are removed; E22 uses the non-diagnostic ENGINE_SAFETY_POLICY without JSPO attribution; E23 JAAF examples remain event/phase context only and generic STRIDE values remain ENGINE_POLICY. Provenance semantics are separated without changing historical SessionItem snapshots or public contracts. Status remains DRAFT and RUNNING_V2_OPEN20_COMPLETED is unchanged.

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 短距離トレーニングの科学と best practice の統合レビュー。一次資料未照合（DR経由の二次報告）。

reference.citation: Haugen 2019 (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: Acceleration: 10–50m / 約2–7分、session volume 100–300m は Haugen の best-practice synthesis。youth 20m/約2分、elite 40m block/約7分は coach examples であり、DEV/ADV tier 境界や普遍的実験閾値ではない。

reference.citation: Haugen T, Seiler S, Sandbakk Ø, Tønnessen E. The Training and Development of Elite Sprint Performance. Sports Medicine - Open 2019;5:44.

evidence.applicabilityNotes: Maximal velocity: build 20–40m / fly 10–30m / recovery 4–15分、session fly volume 50–150m（flying start除外）は best-practice core。fly-zone length（10–30m）と session total fly volume（50–150m）は別。youth/elite の分割例は coach examples であり、DEV/ADV 境界の直接実験値ではない。

reference.citation: Haugen T, Seiler S, Sandbakk Ø, Tønnessen E. The Training and Development of Elite Sprint Performance. Sports Medicine - Open 2019;5:44.

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 7–15秒 / 95–100% / recovery 8–30分 / volume 300–900mはbest-practice synthesis。youth 2–3本・elite 4–6本はcoach examplesであり、universal tier doseではない。

reference.citation: Haugen 2019 (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: Table 2「Summary of best practice sprint training recommendations」より（OPEN20 照合）。Acc 100–300m / MV fly 50–150m（flying start除外）/ SES 300–900m / Speed endurance 600–2000m / Tempo 1000–2000m / Resisted 50–200m（10–30m）。これは best-practice synthesis（著者の推奨であり、世界級スプリンターの実測 training data ではない）。Claude DR の「Acc 100–160m」は誤報告と確定（OPEN-07）。

reference.citation: Haugen T, Seiler S, Sandbakk Ø, Tønnessen E. The Training and Development of Elite Sprint Performance. Sports Medicine - Open 2019;5:44.

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 100–300m、約60–70%Vmax。準備期 約2000m / 試合期 約1000m。elite sprint coaching practice documented in an integrative reviewであり、universal youth doseではない。一次資料未照合。

reference.citation: Haugen 2019 tempo practice (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 一次資料で確認した歴史的コーチング方法。60/80mおよび60/80/100m framework、phase/distance dependentなmicro rest約1:30–4:00、macro rest約6–12分、near-maximal約95–98%の構造を記録する。Haugen 2019 Table 2 の Speed endurance（60–80m, 90–95%）が独立に corroborate。EVIDENCE_INFORMED（Special Endurance / 速度持久）。現代の一般/ユース自動処方ではない。

reference.citation: Carlo Vittori, Pasquale Bellotti, Alessandro Donati, Esperienze sulla resistenza alla velocità dello sprinter, Atleticastudi 1981;5:51–72, FIDAL

evidence.studyDesign: Historical coaching method; primary period source verified during OPEN20 reconciliation

evidence.applicabilityNotes: Haugenによる二次 retelling。60–80m、約90→95%、rep約2分/set約8分は歴史的elite-coach exampleで、Vittori原著のexact prescriptionでも現代の一般/ユース既定値でもない。

reference.citation: Haugen 2019 (Vittori method via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 高強度セッションは通常48h程度離す実践。数値の処方根拠ではなく週次文脈の CHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Haugen 2019 (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 強度帯（95–100 / 76–94 / <75%）、完全/不完全回復の分類。数値根拠ではなく分類の CHECK_ONLY。KNOWN_PRIMARY_SOURCE_GAP: UKA 2019 原文は未入手（secondary 経由のみ）。「疾走1秒につき1–2分の recovery」は heuristic（BEST_PRACTICE_SYNTHESIS）であり、hard physiological law / universal recovery rule ではない。

reference.citation: UKA classification (via Claude Deep Research)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: Petrakos reviewの整理を、LIGHT <10%、MODERATE 10≤x<15%、15–30% unresolved review、VERY_HEAVY >30%として分類にのみ使用。classificationはload prescriptionではない。

reference.citation: Petrakos 2016

evidence.applicabilityNotes: resistedは主に10m/加速に効果。重いほど良いとは言えない。数値根拠ではなく方向性の CONTEXT_ONLY。

reference.citation: Resisted sprint meta-analysis 2024-2025 (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: assistedの長期効果データは限定的。処方の数値根拠にはしない CHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Assisted sprint systematic review (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 週2回・約20m×最大16本・work:rest 1:25 または ≥90秒（男子ユース・主に団体競技）。Fable H-2 により処方には使わない。usage=CONTEXT_ONLYとして型的にEnvelopeから参照不可（T-EV-03）。

reference.citation: Moran 2016 youth resistance/sprint training dose meta-analysis

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 暦年齢・学年から成熟度を確定しない。処方の数値根拠ではなく判定方針の CHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Maturity vs chronological age consensus (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.studyDesign: R2 implementation representation policy: Deep Researchではsystematic review + consensusの複合根拠として報告。現schema（EvidenceRecord.sourceTypeが単一値）ではCONSENSUS_STATEMENTとして代表。一次資料未照合。科学的事実としてではなく代表表記として扱うこと。

evidence.applicabilityNotes: >7.2cm/年はmale academy footballで報告されたgrowth-velocity risk marker。女性・一般陸上へ外挿せず、rapidGrowthFlagのCHECK_ONLYとしてのみ使用する。hard stop/eligibility cutoffではない。

reference.citation: Growth velocity narrative review (via Claude Deep Research)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 一般競技者をpooledしたmeta-analysisの約2週間・volume -41〜60%・intensity/frequency維持。短距離特異的推奨値ではなく、ADVANCED×PEAKのgeneral taper contextとしてのみ参照する。

reference.citation: Bosquet 2007 taper meta-analysis

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 20%BM resisted後の30m低下が72hまで残る報告。数値根拠ではなく週次判断のCHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Resisted sprint recovery study 2023 (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: squat/jump/sprint後の疲労が48-72h残る（n=10成人男性・15×30m・crossover設計。RCTではない。Fable M-9の訂正を反映）。CHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Thomas 2018

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 主観的wellnessは負荷変化に客観指標より一貫して反応する。readiness文脈のCHECK_ONLY。

reference.citation: Wellness monitoring systematic review (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 手動計時の誤差・MDC、timing gateのCV 1.1-2.4%。timing tolerance検討のCHECK_ONLY（数値確定値ではない）。

reference.citation: Manual/electronic timing error observational reports (via Deep Research reports)

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 日本の学校部活動および適用対象となる認定地域クラブに限る現行制度 guidance。休養≥2日/週、平日約2h、休日約3h、週約11hの文脈付き情報であり、U15一般生理閾値ではない。歴史的なJSPO/JASAの<16h/week guidanceとは区別し、runtime universal ruleには使用しない。

reference.citation: スポーツ庁『部活動改革及び地域クラブ活動の推進等に関する総合的なガイドライン』令和7年12月

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 旧JSPO attributionは使用しない。診断ではなく、既存ENGINE_SAFETY_POLICYの一般的な保守的判断（誘発負荷を止める/変更、assessment、持続症状やred flagは医療評価）を表す内部policy record。

reference.citation: SACHIZU Running Prescription Engine v2 — non-diagnostic safety policy

evidence.applicabilityNotes: JAAF official coaching examplesをevent/phase付きで保持する。short sprint specialized preparation 100m×3、competition phase 120m×3、middle/long precompetition 120m×2/3・150m×2、jumps/throwsの例など。generic STRIDE 100–150m×3–4の直接処方ではない。

reference.citation: JAAF『中学校部活動における陸上競技指導の手引き』第4章（wind sprint examples）

evidence.applicabilityNotes: 本アプリのDRAFT ENGINE_POLICY。科学的確定値・safety thresholdではない。tier normalization、timing convention、plausibility、48/72h operational window、unknown-history、phase/competition caps等の実装判断を明示するために参照する。

reference.citation: SACHIZU Running Prescription Engine v2 — internal engine policy
